datasets.name: RapidEye Analytic Ortho Tile multispectral satellite image
datasets.verbatim: We used a RapidEye Analytic Ortho Tile multispectral satellite image (5m resolution) dated 30 January 2014.

datasets.name: 1:10,000 scale map of the drainage network
datasets.source: Geographic and Cartographic Institute of the State of São Paulo (IGC-SP)
datasets.verbatim: A 1:10,000 scale map of the drainage network from the Geographic and Cartographic Institute of the State of São Paulo (IGC-SP) was used in addition.

datasets.name: ALOS Digital Elevation Model (DEM) with 12.5m resolution
datasets.verbatim: Supplementary data for slope, curvature and flow accumulation were derived from the pre-event ALOS Digital Elevation Model (DEM) with 12.5m resolution, acquired from the Alaska Satellite Facility.

datasets.name: Shallow landslide and debris flow inventory
datasets.verbatim: The accuracy of the results was assessed by comparison with a shallow landslide and debris flow inventory, created through expert interpretation (Dias et al., 2022)

methods.name: Semi-automated OBIA approach
methods.summary: The method uses multiresolution segmentation to identify objects based on spectral and shape parameters. Classification of shallow landslides and debris flows is performed using a rule set based on NDVI, slope, and distance/border metrics to the drainage network.
methods.verbatim: For semi-automated mapping and differentiation of landslide types, an object-based approach was applied using eCognition 10.0 (Trimble) software.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced but not linked, and the method's code is not available.
